actions.justification: Mandatory first step - activate stroke team immediately to coordinate rapid evaluation and treatment for suspected stroke.
Critical for determining eligibility for thrombolysis (tPA) and/or thrombectomy - must establish time window.
Mandatory neurological assessment to quantify stroke severity and guide treatment decisions.
Stat CT head is mandatory and must be completed within 60 minutes. It is critical to rule out hemorrhagic stroke before any thrombolytic therapy can be considered.
Mandatory action - hypoglycemia can mimic stroke symptoms and must be ruled out immediately. Blood glucose check is essential in the initial assessment of any suspected stroke.
Mandatory action - IV access is required for administration of medications including potential tPA/thrombolytics and for drawing labs. Must be established early in stroke workup.
Mandatory action: ECG is required to detect atrial fibrillation or other cardiac sources of embolism in acute stroke workup, within the 60-minute deadline.
Mandatory action: CBC, BMP, and coagulation studies are essential for stroke workup to assess eligibility for thrombolysis, identify metabolic causes, and evaluate bleeding risk.

Optional but clinically important: Assessing pre-stroke modified Rankin Scale establishes baseline functional status, which is critical for treatment decision-making (e.g., tPA eligibility and goals of care).
After CT head has been ordered, ASPECTS score should be assessed to evaluate ischemic changes and guide eligibility for reperfusion therapy.
If large vessel occlusion is identified or suspected, the neurointerventional team should be activated early to minimize door-to-groin time for mechanical thrombectomy.
Assessing surgical risk is part of the comprehensive stroke workup to determine candidacy for intervention and guide treatment planning.
Reassess vital signs at 60 minutes to monitor for any hemodynamic changes and guide ongoing management decisions.
Patient with acute stroke presentation requires admission to a stroke unit or ICU for continuous monitoring and specialized stroke care per stroke guidelines.

violation_events.description: Action check_glucose performed 10 min after deadline
